answer: In an agent marketplace trading lantern designs, echo filters, and prism optics, each agent's voting weight equals the tokens it locks in escrow for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities still yields only 100 tokens of total voting weight, so extra accounts buy no extra influence. To control more votes, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for the full lock period.
